summary: Describes the data transport protocols used by WebRTC, the browser technology for real-time audio, video and data. It covers how traffic travels between peers and how it interacts with middleboxes such as firewalls, relays and NAT boxes. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Two friends far apart want to video chat. This document explains the roads and rules their browsers use to send sound, pictures and messages, even when gates and guards in between try to block the way.

questions: what transport protocols does webrtc use
how does webrtc work through firewalls and nat
